newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 11.0/12.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 11.0/12.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 11.0/12.0 percent on Thursday amid ample rupiah liquidity, dealers said.
Dealers said an early central bank injection of some 126 billion rupiah helped eased the rates, which hovered at around 12.0/13.0 percent on Wednesday.
One United States bank dealer said the central bank had been injecting money into the market for several consecutive days and overnight rates have been in a downtrend.
Another local bank dealer said one-week money was at 13.50/13.75 percent and two-week money at 13.75/14.00 percent. One-month money was at 15.0.
The average overnight interbank rate on Wednesday was 11.47 percent compared with 13.44 percent on Tuesday.
